10721|738b752e.name: Novice Warrior
10721|738b752e.text: Are you here to prove yourself as well?

276801|24ed9d67.name: Swift Orange Raptor
276801|24ed9d67.text: <The raptor bares its teeth at you.>

2980|e775a01e.name: Grull Hawkwind
2980|e775a01e.text: Greetings, $N, and welcome to Camp Narache. News of your arrival spread quickly among the tribe.

2981|72360bcb.name: Chief Hawkwind
2981|72360bcb.text: Hail, $c. In my years I have seen many eager $r who wish to prove their worth to the tribe. It should not be forgotten that eagerness is no substitute for wisdom and experience.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3060|d1e27715.name: Gart Mistrunner
3060|d1e27715.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

3064|03bae58c.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|03bae58c.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

We are the preservers of the balance, now and forever, as Cenarius has taught us.  Never forget this.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

3067|0c543544.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

3067|b48f927f.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

3157|1605f087.name: Shikrik
3157|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3188|366172e1.name: Master Gadrin
3188|366172e1.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

3194|57542108.name: Vel'rin Fang
3194|57542108.text: I make sure Sen'jin is supplied with materials from the local beasts. It is an honorable role.

3304|645294fc.name: Master Vornal
3304|645294fc.text: The sands of Durotar are tough and dry compared to the tropical and lush lands we're from, but we Darkspear persevere. Where chief Vol'jin leads, we will follow.

5939|a28d29e1.name: Vira Younghoof
5939|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

6747|ed5e81b7.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|ed5e81b7.text:
What can you do at an inn?

Well when you stay at an inn, you rest very comfortably.  Because of this, you will become "well rested" much more quickly than you would in the wilderness.  When you are well rested, you learn more from experience.

You may also speak with any innkeeper to get a hearthstone, and can later use the hearthstone in order to quickly return to that inn.

7953|a3eec9a8.name: Xar'Ti
7953|a3eec9a8.text: You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

1516-accept.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1516-accept.text:
The time is now, young $c. You've grown strong and your spirit endures like the earth. Following the $c's path shows you have wisdom before even proving yourself.

The element of earth will guide your destiny, becoming part of you if you are ready. But you must stand before the earth itself. If you are ready, then you will see things only $c know of.

Seek out the Felstalkers to the north, and take from them two of their hooves. Return to me then, and we shall speak more of your future.
1516-accept.title: Call of Earth

1516-progress.name: Canaga Earthcaller
1516-progress.text:
Patience is earth's greatest virtue. The earth witnesses the cycle of all things: the mountains becoming deserts; rivers becoming canyons. The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements and it does not tolerate impatience.

The earth beckons you now because a time of conflict draws near. When you return to me successful, then you shall be that much closer to being made whole.

Others will be envious of your wisdom and hate you for their ignorance.
1516-progress.title: Call of Earth

1656-progress.name: Innkeeper Kauth
1656-progress.text:
Yes, young one? What can Kauth do for you?

The journey here from the Mesa can be a tremendous burden for some, but a welcome sight for others. Which is it for you, I wonder?
1656-progress.title: A Task Unfinished

3089-progress.name: Shikrik
3089-progress.text:
So, you've arrived. I was beginning to wonder when you would show yourself. I sent the parchment some time ago--I wasn't sure if it had arrived.

But enough chatter... you're here because you have been chosen, chosen to lead the spiritual lives of our people.
3089-progress.title: Rune-Inscribed Parchment

3094-progress.name: Gart Mistrunner
3094-progress.text: You have arrived. This is good. Our ancestors' spirits have become restless throughout Mulgore and beyond, but I cannot tell why. It will forever be your duty to learn to listen to nature's spirits, and act as their avatar. Be mindful of that.
3094-progress.title: Verdant Note

3376-progress.name: Brave Windfeather
3376-progress.text:
Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death.  It is his head that I seek, $N.

We $r live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back.  If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.
3376-progress.title: Break Sharptusk!

747-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
747-progress.text: Providing meat and feathers for the tribe is the first step in proving yourself as a hunter before the Chief.
747-progress.title: The Hunt Begins

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

750-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
750-progress.text: If you can provide pelts for the tribe I will pass word along to my father, Chief Hawkwind, of your generous deeds.
750-progress.title: The Hunt Continues

753-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
753-progress.text: You look as though you have returned from the plains. Do you have any word from Greatmother Hawkwind?
753-progress.title: A Humble Task

757-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
757-progress.text: Have you completed the Rite of Strength, $N? I require proof of your valor against the enemy of our tribe, the Bristlebacks.
757-progress.title: Rite of Strength

763-progress.name: Baine Bloodhoof
763-progress.text: What brings you to my village, $c?
763-progress.title: Rites of the Earthmother

780-progress.name: Grull Hawkwind
780-progress.text: The aggression of the Battleboars is increasing. Have you sent them a clear message and brought back some snouts and flanks yet?
780-progress.title: The Battleboars

781-progress.name: Chief Hawkwind
781-progress.text: You have a look of concern about you, $N. What news do you bring?
781-progress.title: Attack on Camp Narache

881-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-progress.text: The great cat calls to you, $N.
881-progress.title: Echeyakee

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

92401-accept.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
92401-accept.text:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401-accept.title: A Frightened Request

95204-complete.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-complete.text:
<Oran bites the crest to ensure authenticity.>

Well I'll be. A genuine relic of our home. Mostly intact, too. We need to be extra careful with this one.

Thank you for your aid in restoring our history, $c. I'll see to it that we take good care of this.
95204-complete.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95204-progress.name: Oran Snakewrithe
95204-progress.text: What have you got there, $c? A tasty morsel?
95204-progress.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95805-progress.name: Seer Graytongue
95805-progress.text: <The smoke from the incense rises toward the sky.>
95805-progress.title: Grace of An'she and Mu'sha

96659-progress.name: Kaga Wildhoof
96659-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96659-progress.title: The Adventurer

97003-accept.name: Gur'ak
97003-accept.text:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003-accept.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

99108-accept.name: Krang Stonehoof
99108-accept.text:
Hail, young $c. Though you are not a warrior and I cannot teach you that path, that does not mean you would not benefit from my tutelage.

Before you lies the arena. In it, it matters not who you call mother or whether you wield sword or bow. All are equal, and all learn to sharpen their horns in direct combat.

Will you enter our space, and learn our ways for yourself? You may face any of these novices, or any other willing adversary. I care not which.
99108-accept.title: Sparring Match
